acceptedAnswer.text: A body lift is a surgical procedure that removes excess skin and fat from multiple body areas to improve contour after major weight loss.
When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a licensed hospital setting, it is a well-established and safe procedure.
Initial recovery takes about 2–3 weeks, with full healing over several months.
Yes. Scarring is unavoidable but strategically placed and typically fades over time.
Postoperative discomfort is expected but usually well controlled with medication.

mainEntity.name: Can a body lift be done in one surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some patients undergo a single-stage procedure; others benefit from a staged approach.
Results are long-lasting if body weight remains stable.

mainEntity.name: Who should avoid body lift surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patients with unstable weight, uncontrolled medical conditions, or unrealistic expectations.
